thread:
Maya (CS): quick heads-up — Atlas onboarding blew past expected GPU hours overnight, need a short sync?
Jin (Customer Success): saw that on the dashboard, total GPU hours = 1,420 last 24h vs baseline ~520.
Arjun (SRE): confirmed. Pool saturation peaked at 96% around 02:14 UTC.
Maya (CS): queue depth averaged 14, spiking to 62 at peak. Customers are hitting queued requests for the embedding endpoint.
Lars (AE): Atlas onboarding deadline is next Tue — if this continues renewal sentiment could dip. Any short-term mitigations? :worried:
Arjun (SRE): immediate knobs: enable burst pool for Atlas tenant, cap per-tenant concurrency at 8, and add autoscale buffer +1.
capacity-bot: autoscale event: added +1 GPU to dedicated pool atlas-prod at 02:30 UTC (reason: sustained saturation > 90%).
Jin (Customer Success): thanks bot — can we get an ETA on latency impact after the burst?
Arjun (SRE): p95 latency for generation routes improved from 320ms -> 190ms after the added GPU. Error rate (5xx) dropped from 1.1% -> 0.25%.
Maya (CS): spend forecast update: weekly committed GPU hours now projected +38% vs committed; finance flag triggered.
Lars (AE): pinging finance and the customer — want to be transparent about potential overage and ask if they want to throttle non-critical jobs.
Jin (Customer Success): I'll draft a short status note to Atlas: include spike details, mitigation steps, and offer to run a brief enablement to optimize prompts/batch sizes.
Maya (CS): action items: 1) Arjun to keep burst live for 12h and monitor queue depth + error rate (Arjun) 2) Jin to send status + ask about background job throttling (Jin) 3) Lars to flag renewal risk if spike persists (Lars).
Arjun (SRE): ack. I'll post hourly queue depth snapshots to this thread.
capacity-bot: snapshot 03:30 UTC — queue depth: avg 9, peak 18; pool sat: 62%; p95 latency: 205ms.
Maya (CS): nice improvement, keep monitoring. Also schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow to decide if we need a permanent reserved bump for Atlas.
Lars (AE): noted. I'll tentatively block 30m on the calendar for tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Jin (Customer Success): adding a follow-up checklist to the customer record: "investigate background job throttles, recommend batching changes, review quantization profiles".
Maya (CS): thanks team. If anyone spots a fresh spike reply here. :thumbsup:
Arjun (SRE): will do — posting next snapshot at 04:30 UTC.
